Summary: US-01 Register with my cellphone number
Description:
As a patient, I want to register with my cellphone number, so that I can book clinic visits.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I enter a valid South African cellphone number, when I ask for a PIN, then I receive a one-time PIN by SMS within 60 seconds
- Given I enter the wrong PIN 3 times, when I try again, then my sign-in is paused for 15 minutes
- Given I am signed in, when I add my ID, passport or folder number, then it is saved to my profile

Requirements: FR-01, FR-02

Summary: US-02 See which services run on which days at my branch
Description:
As a patient, I want to see which services run on which days at my branch, so that I do not travel on a day my service is not offered.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I am not signed in, when I open a branch page, then I see each service with its days and hours
- Given a branch is closed on a public holiday, when I view that week, then the day is clearly marked as closed

Requirements: FR-03

Summary: US-03 Book a time slot for the service I need
Description:
As a patient, I want to book a time slot for the service I need, so that I know I will be seen without queueing from dawn.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given a service runs on Tuesdays only, when I choose a Thursday, then the date cannot be selected and the reason is shown
- Given a slot is full, when I view the slot list, then it shows the word Full and cannot be selected
- Given I choose an open slot, when I confirm, then I see a booking reference, branch, date and time
- Given I already have a booking for this service on this day, when I try to book again, then I am told I already have a booking

Requirements: FR-04, FR-05, FR-07

Summary: US-04 Change or cancel my booking
Description:
As a patient, I want to change or cancel my booking, so that someone else can use the slot if I cannot come.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given my slot is more than 2 hours away, when I cancel, then the slot is released and I receive an SMS
- Given my slot is less than 2 hours away, when I try to cancel, then I am asked to call the clinic

Requirements: FR-06

Summary: US-05 Book visits for my child or elderly parent
Description:
As a caregiver, I want to book visits for my child or elderly parent, so that I can manage my family's clinic visits from one phone.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I add a dependant, when I save, then I must confirm their consent and the date is recorded
- Given I have 5 dependants, when I try to add another, then I am told the limit is 5

Requirements: FR-08

Summary: US-06 Get an SMS confirmation and a reminder
Description:
As a patient, I want to get an SMS confirmation and a reminder, so that I do not forget my visit.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I book a visit, when the booking is saved, then I receive a confirmation SMS within 1 minute
- Given I have a visit tomorrow, when it is 15:00 today, then I receive a reminder SMS
- Given any SMS is sent, when I read it, then it shows only clinic, branch, date, time and reference, and no service or condition

Requirements: FR-09, FR-10, FR-11

Summary: US-07 Cancel by replying to the reminder SMS
Description:
As a patient, I want to cancel by replying to the reminder SMS, so that I can cancel without data or a smartphone.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I receive a reminder, when I reply CANCEL, then the booking is cancelled and I get a confirmation SMS

Requirements: FR-12

Summary: US-08 Book a visit for a patient who has no smartphone
Description:
As a reception clerk, I want to book a visit for a patient who has no smartphone, so that every patient can get a booked time.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given a patient gives me their ID, phone or folder number, when I search, then I find their profile
- Given the patient has no profile, when I create one, then the same booking rules apply as online

Requirements: FR-13

Summary: US-09 Print tomorrow's expected-patient list by 15:00
Description:
As a reception clerk, I want to print tomorrow's expected-patient list by 15:00, so that I can pull folders before patients arrive.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given it is 15:00, when I open the list, then it shows tomorrow's bookings sorted by time with folder numbers
- Given I press Print, when the list prints, then it fits on A4 pages

Requirements: FR-14

Summary: US-10 Check in a patient when they arrive
Description:
As a reception clerk, I want to check in a patient when they arrive, so that the nurse knows who is ready and wait times are measured.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given a patient arrives, when I search their reference or phone number, then I can mark them as arrived and the time is saved
- Given the internet is down, when I check in patients, then check-ins are saved and synced when the connection returns

Requirements: FR-15

Summary: US-11 Have unclaimed slots released after 30 minutes
Description:
As a sister-in-charge, I want to have unclaimed slots released after 30 minutes, so that walk-in patients can use time that would be wasted.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given a patient has not checked in, when 30 minutes pass after the slot start, then the booking is marked as a no-show and the slot is added to walk-in capacity

Requirements: FR-16

Summary: US-12 Register walk-in patients and record anyone turned away
Description:
As a reception clerk, I want to register walk-in patients and record anyone turned away, so that walk-ins are still seen and managers see real demand.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given walk-in capacity remains, when I register a walk-in, then they join the day's queue
- Given walk-in capacity is used up, when another patient arrives, then I record them as turned away with a reason

Requirements: FR-17, FR-18

Summary: US-13 Book the patient's follow-up visit before they leave
Description:
As a nurse, I want to book the patient's follow-up visit before they leave, so that follow-ups are not forgotten.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I finish a consultation, when I choose a follow-up date, then the booking is made and the patient receives an SMS

Requirements: FR-19

Summary: US-14 Set daily capacity and slot length for each service
Description:
As a sister-in-charge, I want to set daily capacity and slot length for each service, so that bookings match the staff I actually have.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I set the walk-in share below 30%, when I save, then I see an error and the change is not saved
- Given I change capacity, when I save, then only future dates without bookings are affected

Requirements: FR-20

Summary: US-15 Close a service or the branch on certain days
Description:
As a sister-in-charge, I want to close a service or the branch on certain days, so that patients are not booked when we cannot see them.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given there are bookings on a day I close, when I save the closure, then affected patients receive an SMS asking them to rebook

Requirements: FR-21

Summary: US-16 Manage staff accounts and roles
Description:
As a administrator, I want to manage staff accounts and roles, so that only the right people can see patient information.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given a staff member leaves, when I deactivate their account, then they can no longer sign in
- Given a clerk signs in, when they open the menu, then they cannot see capacity settings or reports

Requirements: FR-22

Summary: US-17 See a daily dashboard for each branch
Description:
As a operations manager, I want to see a daily dashboard for each branch, so that I can plan staff and spot problems early.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I open the dashboard, when I choose a branch and date, then I see bookings, arrivals, no-shows, walk-ins, turned away and average wait
- Given I use a screen reader, when I reach a chart, then the same figures are available as a table

Requirements: FR-23

Summary: US-18 Export monthly figures as CSV
Description:
As a operations manager, I want to export monthly figures as CSV, so that I can report to the district office.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given I choose a month, when I press Export, then a CSV file downloads with one row per branch per day

Requirements: FR-24
